name: domain-mcp
description: Manage Dynadot domains, DNS, WHOIS, nameservers, transfers, and aftermarket through MCP.
long_description: Domain MCP exposes Dynadot domain-management operations to Claude, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and other MCP-compatible clients. It supports domain registration and renewal, DNS and DNSSEC, WHOIS contacts, nameservers and glue records, transfers, account settings, folders, orders, and aftermarket operations.
